Description
The 100 x 1 gram Gold Valcambi CombiBar (In Assay) with .9999 purity is now available at Bullion Trading LLC. It is made of a sheet of 100 stamped CombiBars inside an assay card. The 100 gram Valcambi Gold CombiBar is a worthy investment because it can be broken down into smaller 1-gram bars and has a low premium.
This 100 gram Valcambi gold combibar comprises 100 intricate bars combined to form a single bar. The CombiBar means divisible bar, and the CombiBar technology creates exact breakpoints for each bar so that if an investor chooses to break the bar into fragments, the products can be easily broken without losing the weight or metal of the product.
Investing in gold CombiBars offers a hedge against inflation, economic instability, and geopolitical risk. And with 100 x 1 gram gold Valcambi combibar, you can invest in gold with ease and convenience. So why wait? Start your investment journey today with 100 x 1 gram Gold Valcambi CombiBar (In Assay).
An assay card protects each
gold bar
to protect it from any external damage and preserves its beauty.
Design of 100 x 1 gram Gold Valcambi CombiBar (In Assay)
Each 1
gram gold bar
consists of the Valcambi logo on the font. The weight, mint, and purity are listed on the back of the bar. The 100 intricately designed bars are united to form the Valcambi bar weighing 100 grams, each with a unique serial number. The weight and authentication of the bar are specified in the assay card, assuring the customer that it is genuine.
